lesson.readable_text:
Item 1 — Tutorial: Introduction

Content:
When we have a range of measurements, we can use a line plot to visualize the data. It shows a count of how many times certain numbers appear in the data.

Content:
The following line plot shows the number of home runs each player in a baseball team hit during a season.

Graphic:
[IMG: /graphics/9544121cf96bcb4ce2250dc3983dab90]

Content:
Each number is divided into equidistant marks on a horizontal line. Every cross above each number represents a different player who has hit that many home runs.

Content:
We can use the line plot to analyze the data. For instance, how many players hit at least [MATH: 3] home runs?

Content:
The plot tells us that:

Content:
- [MATH: {\color{blue}2}] players have hit [MATH: 0] home runs
- [MATH: {\color{blue}3}] players have hit [MATH: 1] home run
- [MATH: {\color{blue}3}] players have hit [MATH: 2] home runs
- [MATH: {\color{red}4}] players have hit [MATH: 3] home runs
- [MATH: {\color{red}2}] players have hit [MATH: 4] home runs
- [MATH: {\color{red}1}] player has hit [MATH: 5] home runs

Graphic:
[IMG: /graphics/47571f7c997700a45bd8bfb68a6ffe3f]

Content:
Therefore, a total of [MATH: 4+2+1=7] players have hit at least [MATH: 3] home runs.

---

Item 2 — Example: Finding the Most Common Value in a Line Plot

Example Prompt:
The line plot below shows the ages of the members in a judo class. Each cross represents a different member. What is the most common age of a member in this class?

[IMG: /graphics/f7a85fe990df3e01e5ef7fcfc1ac070e]

Content:
EXPLANATION

Explanation:
The plot tells us that:

- there are [MATH: {\color{blue}2}] members who are [MATH: 7]-years-old,
- there are [MATH: {\color{blue}4}] members who are [MATH: 8]-years-old,
- there are [MATH: {\color{blue}4}] members who are [MATH: 9]-years-old.
- there are [MATH: {\color{red}5}] members who are [MATH: 10]-years-old,
- there are [MATH: {\color{blue}2}] members who are [MATH: 11]-years-old,
- there is [MATH: {\color{blue}1}] member who is [MATH: 12]-years-old.

[IMG: /graphics/78b2903b1fedb14dd9e5ca5b66fc9557]

Therefore, [MATH: 10] is the most common age of a member of the judo class.
